title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
description: Ten documented Saint Mary’s spaces for studying, gathering, meals, activity, and quiet reflection.

cards.title: Student Center
cards.subtitle: Campus common meeting place
cards.notes: Start here when you need a central indoor meeting point: the building combines student organizations, meeting rooms, an atrium, dining access, and campus services.
cards.short_summary: A campus hub that brings organizations, services, meeting rooms, and dining together.
cards.evidence_claim: The College catalog describes the Student Center as a common meeting place and lists meeting rooms, a large atrium, student-organization offices, services, and dining access.
cards.source_title: Campus and Buildings | Saint Mary's College, Notre Dame, IN
cards.access_notes: Use campus access guidance and any event or room-reservation requirements.

cards.title: Rice Commons
cards.subtitle: Inside the Student Center
cards.notes: Use this named Student Center space as a waypoint when coordinating with classmates or campus offices; confirm any event setup or reservation needs before planning a gathering.
cards.short_summary: A named commons within the Student Center’s mix of student-facing spaces.
cards.evidence_claim: The College catalog lists Rice Commons among the spaces in the Student Center.
cards.source_title: Campus and Buildings | Saint Mary's College, Notre Dame, IN
cards.access_notes: Located in the Student Center; availability may vary with campus programming.

cards.title: Noble Family Dining Hall
cards.subtitle: Student Center dining hall
cards.notes: Plan a meal or a seated catch-up here, then use the Student Center’s nearby common areas for conversation. Check current campus dining eligibility and service details.
cards.short_summary: The College’s named dining hall, entered through the Student Center.
cards.evidence_claim: The College catalog identifies Noble Family Dining Hall as part of the Student Center and notes that the Student Center is its entrance.
cards.source_title: Campus and Buildings | Saint Mary's College, Notre Dame, IN
cards.access_notes: Food service may require a meal plan, Flex Points, or another payment method.

cards.title: Vander Vennet Theatre
cards.subtitle: Student Center performance venue
cards.notes: Check the campus calendar for a show or presentation, and arrive through the Student Center. Treat it as an event venue rather than an always-open lounge.
cards.short_summary: A named theatre in the Student Center for scheduled performances and presentations.
cards.evidence_claim: The campus map lists Vander Vennet Theatre as a performance venue in the Student Center.
cards.access_notes: Attend during scheduled events; ticketing or reservations may apply.

cards.title: Cushwa-Leighton Library
cards.subtitle: Library study and research spaces
cards.notes: Choose a quiet workstation for solo work or reserve a group room when collaborating. The library also puts academic support and technology resources in the same building.
cards.short_summary: A library with individual workstations, group rooms, research help, and student-centered spaces.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Mary’s says Cushwa-Leighton Library has reservable group study rooms and quiet individual workstations throughout the building.
cards.access_notes: Group study rooms are reservable; follow library access and reservation policies.

cards.title: Trumper Computer Center
cards.subtitle: Lower level of Cushwa-Leighton Library
cards.notes: Use the lower-level computer center for a focused computer-based work session, especially when you need campus printing or access to installed academic software.
cards.short_summary: A library computer center with student access around the clock during the school year.
cards.evidence_claim: The College catalog states that the Trumper Computer Center is in the lower level of Cushwa-Leighton Library and offers students 24-hour access when classes are in session.
cards.source_title: Campus and Buildings | Saint Mary's College, Notre Dame, IN
cards.access_notes: 24-hour student access is stated for times when classes are in session; verify current building access rules.

cards.title: Center for Academic Innovation
cards.subtitle: Third floor, Cushwa-Leighton Library
cards.notes: Bring a partner or project group to this flexible third-floor space for study, meetings, or socializing, and check its programming before relying on a specific setup.
cards.short_summary: A flexible Learning Commons space for meetings, study, and socializing.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Mary’s describes the Center for Academic Innovation as a flexible space for faculty and student meetings, study space, and socializing on the library’s third floor.
cards.source_title: Center for Academic Innovation | Saint Mary's College
cards.access_notes: Located on the third floor of Cushwa-Leighton Library; programming may affect availability.

cards.title: Niner’s Lounge
cards.subtitle: McCandless Hall
cards.notes: If you live in McCandless, use this renovated lounge for a small study session, cooking, or gathering. Respect residence-hall guest and kitchen policies.
cards.short_summary: A renovated McCandless lounge designed for cooking, gathering, and studying.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Mary’s states that Niner’s Lounge in McCandless Hall was renovated to create spaces to cook, gather, and study.
cards.access_notes: Residential space; access is subject to residence-life and guest policies.

cards.title: Angela Athletic & Wellness Complex
cards.subtitle: Recreation, fitness, and social areas
cards.notes: Build a movement break around the field house, track, or fitness spaces, then regroup in the café and social area. Confirm facility access and program schedules first.
cards.short_summary: A recreation and wellness complex with fitness spaces and a social area.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Mary’s lists a three-court field house, elevated track, fitness-class spaces, café, and social area among Angela’s facilities.
cards.source_title: Belles Athletics & Sports | Saint Mary's College
cards.access_notes: Facility access and fitness offerings may be scheduled or restricted to eligible users.

cards.title: Holy Spirit Chapel
cards.subtitle: Third floor, Le Mans Hall
cards.notes: Stop by for quiet reflection or worship in this chapel on Le Mans Hall’s third floor. Keep the setting contemplative and follow any posted worship guidance.
cards.short_summary: A historic campus chapel that the College describes as open around the clock.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Mary’s says Holy Spirit Chapel is on the third floor of Le Mans Hall and is open 24 hours a day for students’ reflection and worship.
cards.source_title: Holy Spirit Chapel Celebrates its Centennial | Saint Mary's College
cards.access_notes: The College describes the chapel as open 24 hours daily; observe quiet and any posted religious-service guidance.
